name: 26961-structuredjson-1.7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU. Sealed in configs/env.yaml.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM engine on one GPU, `distributed-executor-backend: mp`.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), 28 layers, 16 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 2048, vocabulary 151936, tied embeddings, bf16, 40960-token window.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=800, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 5000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 26961.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 481 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens with min == max, and every request constrained to the JSON schema carried verbatim in configs/scenario.json.
purpose: A schema-constrained form-filling API on a small Qwen model, serving 800 concurrent short requests on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false

# pinned, not defaulted: an in-process engine build resolves these to 128 and 2048.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
